kn5000-98j: 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b, sub-lane accvar): the play-time section state machine is traced and named (notes/open4-kn5000-b/accvar/README.md). The style-control buttons set request bits in the style record (record 0x48 field 5: bit 2 INTRO1, 3 COUNT IN, 4/5 ENDING1/2, 6/7 FILL IN1/2; field 6 bit 2 INTRO2; field 7 bits 4-5 VARIATION), which are also the LEDs; the routines that did this were misnamed AccPedal_SustainOn/_HoldOn/_PortamentoOn... and are now AccStyleCtl_* / AccSection_* in all trees (scripts/renaming/rename_open4_accvar.sed, 277 rules). INTRO & ENDING gives an intro when stopped, an ending when running (front-panel events only); FILL IN 2 when stopped gives COUNT IN. SeqTick_ReadControlState copies the bits into ACC_REQ_INTRO/FILLIN/ENDING each tick; a rising edge latches a pending section (AccSection_Latch*Requests). A fill-in or intro starts at once unless pressed on the last beat (then at the bar line); an ending waits for the bar line unless pressed on the first beat. AccSection_SwitchAtBarLine dispatches through AccSection_BarLineSwitchTable (ending > fill-in > intro; a pending variation loads first); under the MUSIC STYLE ARRANGER FILL IN 1/2 step the variation down/up. A section ends when its last lane reaches the end marker (Rhythm_SaveState clears the request and the LED; after a fill or intro the variation resumes, after an ending 0x3284 bit 2 is set, the same bit as after a fill, so the stop after an ending is not established). RAM names added (ACC_REQ_*, ACC_PENDING_*, ACC_LANES_*, ACC_DEFER_*, ACC_SECTION_BUTTONS_HELD, PANEL_EVENT_SOURCE ...; v10/v9/v7, notes/open4-kn5000-b/accvar/ram-names.txt). Website draft for accompaniment-engine.md: README section 'Website page draft'. Chord recognition was done by the engine sub-lane (notes/open4-kn5000-b/engine/README.md). NOT done: the transposition of pattern notes to the chord (proposed as a new issue with leads), the BREAK half of SYNCHRO & BREAK and synchro stop.

new-issues.title: Accompaniment: transposition of rhythm-ROM pattern notes to the recognized chord (root shift, chord-type note rule)
new-issues.description: Split from kn5000-98j (2026-10-31; chord recognition: notes/open4-kn5000-b/engine/README.md, section switching: notes/open4-kn5000-b/accvar/README.md). Remaining: how a lane's pattern note becomes the played note for the current chord. Leads: AccChord_ReadAndStoreKeys copies the chord into 0x32d8 / 0x32da (AccChord_CompareAndSetDirty compares with 0x32dc / 0x32de and raises 0x32f3 bit 5); the lane note writers AccBuf_WriteNoteEvent, AccVoice_WriteNoteEventToBuffer and AccPlay_ProcessNoteEvent are where a root shift and a chord-type table must apply. Note_PitchClassTable / ToneGen_PitchClassNoteFormTable are NOT transposition tables (they pick the 0x90/0x91 event form of the composer's writer). Also: the voicing source of chord types 31-39 and the chord mode that uses NoteMask9_ClassTable (open from the engine sub-lane).

new-issues.title: Accompaniment: SYNCHRO & BREAK while running (break) and synchro stop
new-issues.description: Split from kn5000-98j (2026-10-31, notes/open4-kn5000-b/accvar/README.md section 6). SYNCHRO armed = PANEL_STYLE+5 bit 1 (AccStyleCtl_SynchroButton toggles it) and the synchro start through 0x346d / INTTR4_SeqAutoStart are traced; what the button does while the accompaniment runs (BREAK) and whether releasing all chord keys stops it (synchro stop, AccAutoPlay_SubModeA/B) are not. Also: where the accompaniment stops after an ENDING finishes (0x3284 bit 2 is set for an ending and a fill alike, so it is not the stop).
